PDF_Summary: Step-by-Step Guide: 1. xTex generated Maps CLO uses the Color Map, Normal Map, and Roughness Map among the xTex generated Maps. These maps are used to apply color, texture, and shininess to fabric in CLO. 2. How to apply xTex files: a. Navigate to the Object Browser > Fabric. b. Drag and drop the xTex file onto the desired pattern. This will apply the xTex file to that specific pattern piece. c. To apply the xTex file to multiple pattern pieces, hold down the SHIFT key and select the desired pattern pieces. Then, drag and drop the xTex file onto any of the selected pattern pieces. This will apply the xTex file to all selected pattern pieces. d. Alternatively, you can right-click on the intended fabric in the Object Browser > Fabric, and select "Import xTex File" from the drop-down menu. Then, find and open the desired xTex file. 3. After applying the xTex file: The xTex file will apply the Color Map, Normal Map, and Roughness Map all at once. Here is a brief explanation of what each map does: - Color Map: This map contains color information and is used to apply specific colors to the fabric. - Normal Map: This map expresses the realistic fabric texture, giving it a textured appearance. - Roughness Map: This map expresses the fabric's shininess, allowing you to control how reflective or matte the fabric appears. 4. Adjusting Map Intensity: a. To adjust the intensity of the Normal Map, use the provided slider or change the number value. A lower intensity value will make the fabric texture less pronounced, while a higher intensity value will make it more pronounced. b. To adjust the intensity of the Roughness Map, use the provided slider or change the number value. A higher intensity value will make the fabric appear shinier, while a lower intensity value will make it appear less shiny.
